segments.text: What if every human disappeared… right now?
Within hours, power plants shut down, and the lights go out.
In just 2 days, subway tunnels fill up with water.
Wild animals move into the empty streets.
We've seen it happen: around Chernobyl, wolves and wild horses moved in.
After 20 years, trees break through roads and rooftops.
After 300 years, rusty towers and bridges crash down.
And after 10,000 years? Almost every city is gone, buried under forest.
But one thing would last for millions of years…
our footprints on the Moon. The last sign we were ever here.
